init.title: Warsaw Public Transport
init.description:
**This entry uses the City's old API ({current}).**

It works, but the City has published no date for its end, and the new API is its current service.

To switch:

1. Get a token at [dane.um.warszawa.pl/pl/key-api]({portal}).
2. Paste it below.

The stop and the line stay as they are.

token.title: Warsaw Public Transport
token.description:
**Replace the token of this entry.**

Paste the new token from [dane.um.warszawa.pl/pl/key-api]({portal}), for example when the old one has expired.

The stop and the line stay as they are.

duplicate_entry.title: Already configured: line {line}, {stop}
duplicate_entry.description:
**The line {line} at {stop} is set up twice.**

Home Assistant can only show one sensor for it, so the second entry has none.

Remove one of the two entries: **Settings > Devices & services > Warsaw Public Transport**.

token.title: Replace the old key
token.description:
**The line {line} still uses a key of the City's old API.**

It works, but the City has published no date for its end. The new API with a token is the current service.

Paste a token from [dane.um.warszawa.pl/pl/key-api]({portal}) below; it replaces the old key and the stops stay as they are.

You can also choose *Ignore* to keep the old key for now.

merged_keys.title: Line {line}: the stops used different keys
merged_keys.description:
**The stops of line {line} used different keys.**

They are one entry now, so the line uses one key: a token when one of them was a token, otherwise the key of the oldest entry.

If a stop stops working, open the integration, choose **Configure** on this entry and enter the key you want.

You can dismiss this notice.
